issue: The new incomplete_skill_vectors gate tests vector presence, not currency. requiredVectorRows.some((skill) => !cachedVectors.has(skill.id)) accepts any stored row, and loadSkillEmbeddings returns rows without filtering on content_hash or model_id. So a skill whose SKILL.md description changed while its re-embed failed keeps its old vector, passes the gate, and is scored against the previous description while the lane reports no incomplete_skill_vectors. The changelog (changelog/v1.3.0.0.md:24) and references/scoring/advisor-scorer.md:79 both claim the lane "scores only with current vectors for every embeddable skill and command", which the code does not do. The new test proves the gap: semantic-shadow-cosine.vitest.ts:222 inserts content_hash "hash-alpha", which is not the description hash, and the lane still scores that row. advisor_status meanwhile reports coverageComplete:false and stale:1 for the same row, so the two surfaces disagree. Reach: a skill description edit plus an embedding backend failure, both explicitly handled paths (backendOutage at skill-graph-db.ts:1592, probeOllamaModel early return at skill-graph-db.ts:1462). Impact is bounded because the lane default weight is 0 (lane-registry.ts:13) and the score shift is one row at weight 0.05.

evidence.out: Test Files 6 passed (6) | Tests 73 passed (73) - the suite passes with a non-matching content_hash, confirming the gate ignores currency
